parameters.approval: 2026-09-18 user approved all 29 store-facility matches; data-only, no runtime import

gtx.daily_baseline: Preserve GTX_PROXY_V1 daily direction totals; historical mixed-population proxy, not observed July 2026
gtx.calendar: target weekday, separate boarding/alighting shares; assumed operating window, not verified timetable

parking.boundary_prior: June 29-30 same-weekday July nearest day arrival templates, estimated carry-in; departure tail through August 2 retained

allocation.method: time-expanded doubly constrained gravity, sparse IPF, explicit nonspatial unknown boundary

commercial.metric_definition: 결제건수 기준. 실방문자·고유 인원 또는 구매 동행인원으로 환산하지 않음
commercial.seed_storage: private only, excluded from deliverables and archive
commercial.note: Controlled perturbation, not formally anonymous or differential-private. No raw values, reversal factors or seed in deliverables. Product quantities and sales amounts suppressed. Prices retained.

hourly_profile.vat: ratios computed before tax conversion; common 1/1.1 factor cancels
hourly_profile.precision: round source proportions to 1,000,000 integer units then divide
hourly_profile.daily_allocation: same monthly composition each date; preserve all observed sales hours including outside registered hours; NO CLIPPING; sales and transactions separately largest-remainder, sales 100 KRW
hourly_profile.transaction_timing: estimated proxy using sales composition, not observed hourly customer counts
hourly_profile.missing_profile: nearest approved direct-profile shop by 3D local metric distance; stable code tie break; fail if location or all donors absent; no donor chains
hourly_profile.user_correction: Actual sales activity takes precedence over registered operating hours; discrepancy metadata only

limitations: GTX total remains weak historical proxy; all new hourly values estimated
parking departures use assumed duration and June carry-in
unobserved taxis/walks are residuals, not measured separate modes
route geometry is existing draft, no direction/control field verification
commercial values are perturbed, not a formal anonymity guarantee
Local map inspected and one missing Storyway facility registered; no commercial data imported or public deployment
Store IDs approved; hourly customer counts are inferred from monthly sales composition, not observed hourly payment counts
All observed sales hours retained, including outside registered hours, per user correction; no hours clipping
Facility-specific stop/dwell detours are not yet applied to OD paths; no final app implementation
